name: idle
meaning: 1 when no delivery camera is running

name: hasRock
meaning: LVL03ROCK != 0 (only the Lvl-03 mailbox with designer boxes)

name: deliveryPending
meaning: set to request a delivery; consumed by Mailbox_Update when no cinematic is active

name: boxes
meaning: container per item: the BOX1..4 designer objects, or the box/FloatingBox objects created at init from the records at +0x9c/+0x11c

name: items
meaning: the O1..O4 objects, removed from the world at init and handed to the boxes at delivery

name: boxRecords
meaning: synthesised WAR records for box_Create, built by 0x49d27d(rec, &itemSpawnPos[n], itemId) when !floatingBoxes

name: itemSpawnPos
meaning: copy of each item's record+4 (designer position); where generated boxes are added to the world

name: opener
meaning: the sender of msg 1 (Wolf or Robot). Frozen with msg 0xE when the delivery camera starts, unfrozen with msg 0xF when cameraTimer > cameraTimeMs or on Reset. Cleared by msg 0xE (e.g. when a cinematic takes the Wolf). Not the delivered item

name: floatingBoxes
meaning: (u16)FLOATINGBOXES: generated containers are FloatingBox (class 143) instead of box (class 14). Set on one mailbox in Lvl-15

name: floatingBoxRecords
meaning: synthesised records for FloatingBox_Create, built by 0x4c1e2a when floatingBoxes

name: cameraTimer
meaning: accumulates g_dtMs while the delivery camera runs (double-truncated ms: runs ~4% slow at 60 FPS)

name: camera
meaning: IDCAMERA list[0] camera resource {u16 focal +0; s16 [3] +2..+6; data +8}, passed to Camera_StartScripted with flags 3 and duration 0x1000. NULL = no freeze and no camera (one mailbox in Lvl-09)
